de: Russian cyclist Angelina Novolodskaya won the bronze of the Youth Olympic Games in Dakar. In an individual road race with a separate start on November 10, she covered 8.5 kilometers in 11 minutes 43.65 seconds.

de: In several municipalities of the Luhansk People’s Republic, boiler houses and pumping stations were temporarily shut down after a night-time strike on the energy infrastructure. This was reported in the government of the region.

d: Делегации России, США и Украины завершили первый день переговоров в Абу-Даби. Встреча 10 ноября заняла четыре с половиной часа, включая перерыв примерно на 40 минут. Переговоры продолжатся утром 11 ноября.

de: The delegations of Russia, the United States and Ukraine have completed the first day of talks in Abu Dhabi. The November 10 meeting took four and a half hours, including a break of about 40 minutes. Negotiations will continue on the morning of November 11.

de: The Ministry of Health of Russia has registered two new drugs for patients with rare diseases. One is designed to treat chronic liver disease, the second helps prevent bleeding in people with severe hemophilia.

te: Rockets deep underground: Iran reveals new secret military city
de: Iran has unveiled a new underground missile system of the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC). Ballistic and cruise missiles, as well as launchers, were placed at the facility. This was reported by the Iranian news agency Mehr.

de: Problems of the future employer can be seen even before employment, said career consultant Oksana Semyonova. According to her, it is important for the applicant to evaluate the company himself, and not only to try to like it.
